headline: The IOI name-mover backbone is universal across GPT-2 scale and into working Pythia, but the fixed-circuit's faithfulness falls with GPT-2 size (slope −0.61/decade, R²=0.75, n=4; anchor 87.8% → large 11.5%) and generation dominates size behaviourally — the whole Pythia family fails IOI while GPT-2 and modern small models succeed.

metrics.note: overturns flat-faithfulness prior WITHIN GPT-2, but not significant; anchor 87.8% → medium 41.5% → large 11.5%

metrics.note: 001 fixed the discovered circuit at 26 heads/6 classes by template, so size is constant by construction — cannot test growth from 001 artifacts

tables.title: Class-persistence: strong heads (|Δlogit-diff|≥0.2) per class × model [from 001 per_model/*.json]
Scale fits on log₁₀(params) — coefficient + R² (n small; read with care)

figures.caption: Strong IOI heads (|Δlogit-diff|≥0.2) per class × model. Name-mover (top row) is the only class strong at every GPT-2 rung and on working Pythia; S-inhibition and the induction/duplicate/previous-token chain are strong essentially only in GPT-2-small. n/r = discovery config not run in 001 (budget), grey — distinct from a true 0.
figures.alt: 6×8 heatmap; top name-mover row dark across GPT-2 (9,11,8,5) fading in Pythia (2,1,1,0); other classes near-zero except GPT-2-small column; grey n/r cells for gpt2-xl and pythia-2.8b.

figures.caption: Discovered-circuit faithfulness F(C)/F(M) vs log-params. GPT-2 falls from 88.6% (small) to 11.5% (large); fit slope −0.61/decade, R²=0.75 (n=4, p=0.13). gpt2-xl (open marker) is a 3-class partial. Pythia-1.4b (diamond, the only Pythia with F(M)>0) sits on the anchor line. Dashed = GPT-2-small anchor 87.8%. Pythia 70m/410m/2.8b omitted (F(M)≤0).
figures.alt: Log-x scatter: GPT-2 points descending with a downward fit line; a single Pythia-1.4b diamond high near 0.88 on the dashed anchor line.

figures.caption: Baseline IOI mean logit-diff (IO−S) vs log-params. GPT-2 family (3.5–4.5) and modern small models Qwen2.5-0.5B/SmolLM2-1.7B (4.2–5.1, Tier-2 behavioural) all solve IOI; the entire Pythia family sits at or below zero (fails), except a weak pythia-1.4b (+0.85). Generation, not size, decides.
figures.alt: Log-x line plot: blue GPT-2 and green modern-small lines well above 3; orange Pythia line near/below zero across all sizes.

notes: No new GPU jobs: every number is from 001-living-update artifacts (per_model/*.json, followup_summary.json) or this session's numpy/scipy fits; anchors read from run/replication (step2/step8). Strong-head recomputation reproduces 001's card head-counts exactly.

Biggest limitation: circuit head-count scaling is untestable because 001 fixed the discovered circuit at a 26-head/6-class template — the requested #heads-vs-scale fit is degenerate. Named gap (not filled, would be new GPU): re-run 001's dropped greedy/minimality search (C19/C21) on 2–3 rungs for a size-varying circuit.
Faithfulness fits use ≤5 points, none significant; within-GPT-2 collapse is partly template/reduced-N artifact (path-patch N=30 for large/xl vs 100 for small). Not a law.
gpt2-xl (3-class) and pythia-2.8b (2-class) are 001 partials; their missing class cells are n/r, not 0. Faithfulness ratios excluded where F(M)≤0 (pythia-70m/410m/2.8b fail IOI).

Tier-2 differs from the instruction's named set (Qwen2.5-0.5B/Llama-3.2-3B/gemma-2-2b): 001 produced Qwen2.5-0.5B & SmolLM2-1.7B, which I used; behavioural-only, never mixed into circuit-structure fits.
